g.text: Already attacked both problems; deployed at Kuaishou since March 2024
pairs: items clicked together (Swing), and a clicked
item + the most similar of the last 50 clicks
codes = new ID features with learnable embeddings
used as item, user-sequence and target-aware
Key lesson of v1: the aligned embedding as a frozen feature gave +0.02 AUC; as learnable codes, +0.18.
QARM (arXiv:2411.11739): §3, Table 1 (Advertising CTR AUC); K, L, d from the hyper-parameter section
